overview.heading: What is on the Wetherspoons kids menu?
overview.body:
The Wetherspoons kids menu includes chicken, pork, beef, fish and plant-based meals, rather than just smaller versions of one pub dish. [Kids Chicken Nuggets](/kids-menu/kids-chicken-nuggets) contain five battered chicken breast nuggets, while Kids Fish Fingers contain three breaded cod fish fingers. Kids Beef Burger takes a simpler approach: a smaller, mildly seasoned beef patty in a plain white bun, without complex sauces or salads.

For a different format, [Kids Sausages and Mash](/kids-menu/kids-sausages-mash) combines two pork sausages with mashed potato and garden peas. [Kids Margherita Pizza](/kids-menu/kids-margherita-pizza) has a thin, crispy base, tomato sauce and mozzarella. Kids Tomato Pasta offers tubular pasta in smooth tomato sauce, and Kids Vegan Sausages features two Quorn vegan sausages. These distinctions help you choose by texture and flavour, not just by the meal name.

overview.heading: How big are Wetherspoons kids meals?
overview.body:
The Wetherspoons kids meals are described as tailored to younger appetites, but exact portion weights are not supplied. The clearest size information is the item count: five chicken nuggets, three fish fingers or two sausages in the respective meals. The burger uses a smaller patty, and the margherita is described as a smaller pizza. That does not establish how filling each complete plate will be for an individual child.

Format is a useful second consideration. Separate nuggets or fish fingers offer distinct pieces, while tomato pasta is a bowl-based meal with the sauce mixed through. Sausages and mash provides a soft potato accompaniment; pizza offers a crisp base with a cheese topping. Ask the pub about the full plate and available accompaniments before comparing portions.

Before ordering, check the local description for the complete package, including any drink choices and whether an extra charge applies. This matters when comparing typical prices, because a main meal alone and a meal with a drink are not equivalent purchases. If the description is unclear, ask staff to explain what the displayed price covers.

No seasonal or rotating kids meals are identified in the supplied menu details. Kids Margherita Pizza and Kids Tomato Pasta should be judged on their stated descriptions rather than on possible variations.
